# Figure plan (generated by tools/design_docs.py from figure_plan.py; do not edit by hand)

MODEL v2.0.0 (design: [FIGURE_PLAN_v2.md](FIGURE_PLAN_v2.md); sensitivity rows: [SENSITIVITY_PLAN.md](SENSITIVITY_PLAN.md)). Three sets. **Paper** (`outputs/paper/`): Fig1-Fig6 at Nature widths (183 mm double, 89 mm single column), PNG 300 dpi, vector PDF and source-data CSV, Tables 1-2, with `PAPER.md` (findings, every figure with its caption, the tables). **Extended Data** (`outputs/extended_data/`): ED1-ED10, same formats, with `EXTENDED_DATA.md`. **Diagnostics** (`outputs/diagnostics/<group>/`): every other figure, PNG 300 dpi, indexed in `DIAGNOSTICS.md`. All figures use `style.py` (docs/PALETTE.md) and the vocabulary of `naming.py` (docs/RENAMING.md). Caption numbers are read from the data files when the figure is drawn. Maintenance (B2, B4) is drawn as its own layer only in Fig2_demand_bands, Fig3_reference_carbon, Fig4_pathways_bands, D25_annual_carbon_by_band, D26_cumulative_carbon_by_band (figure audit; tests/test_release.py).

## Paper

### Fig1. How the model works

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig1_model_schematic.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: one panel: population -> households -> dwellings required -> floor area -> embodied carbon -> level of exceedance against the AESA boundaries (AR, AtP); the demand bands branch off the dwellings step, each lever (L1-L5) attached to the band or quantity it acts on; P1-P5 group the levers; TL1-TL7 at the end of the same arrows; untargeted bands marked
* Data: naming.py, levers.py (structure only; no numbers)
* Draft caption: Model structure. A bottom-up chain converts population and household projections into dwellings required, floor area by reason for building (demand bands) and embodied carbon, which is compared with two allocations of a global carrying capacity (acquired rights, AR; ability to pay, AtP). Pathway levers act on the band or quantity they target; population growth and smaller households are untargeted by design.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H1; (v3.1): new

### Fig2. Why floor area is built

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig2_demand_bands.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: (a) floor area by demand band: history one column per census interval with the census-measured net replacement and the unexplained building (hatched, neutral; may be negative), Reference projection annual 2026-2050; (b) the Reference bands as embodied carbon per year, maintenance (B2, B4) as its own layer
* Data: data/baseline/bands_history.csv, data/baseline/bands_history_replacement_split.csv, data/baseline/bands_annual.csv
* Draft caption: Floor area and carbon by reason for building. Bands sum to the in-scope total. Population growth and smaller households are untargeted; extra space, vacancy, the 2026 overbuild, historical replacement and the recent replacement surge are the bands the pathways act on.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H3; (v3.1): diag_4_floor_area, boss_04_annual_gfa

### Fig3. Embodied carbon of the Reference

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig3_reference_carbon.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: (a) annual carbon 2026-2050 by life-cycle stage (A1-A3, A4-A5, maintenance B2/B4, soil carbon loss); (b) the same carbon by material, soil carbon loss on top; (c) cumulative carbon 2026-2050 and the emissions committed after 2050 (lower-upper, hatched), second axis in years of the 2050 AR boundary
* Data: data/baseline/annual_by_stage.csv, data/baseline/annual_by_material.csv, data/aesa/results.json
* Draft caption: Embodied carbon of new residential construction in the Reference. Materials (A1-A3), construction (A4-A5) and soil carbon loss are counted in the construction year, maintenance (B2, B4) in the year it occurs within 2026-2050; later events and end of life are committed after 2050 (c, hatched).
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H4, H6; (v3.1): boss_05_annual_carbon, boss_06_cumulative_carbon, boss_10_material_flows, diag_5_carbon, pb_6_committed

### Fig4. What each pathway removes, by demand band

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig4_pathways_bands.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: (a) floor area and (b) carbon 2026-2050 by demand band for the Reference, P1-P5 and TL; untargeted bands grouped at the bottom; maintenance its own layer in (b); change vs the Reference on each bar; cumulative AR and AtP budgets as short lines in (b)
* Data: data/pathways/bands.csv, data/pathways/runs.csv
* Draft caption: Pathways by demand band (each pathway at its Moderate setting, full roll-out by 2035). Each pathway acts on the bands it targets; P4 lowers carbon per m2 of every band. TL: hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H7; (v3.1): pw_1_bands_by_pathway

### Fig5. Emissions against the boundaries, and what closes the gap

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig5_boundaries_attribution.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (183 mm)
* Panels: (a) annual emissions of the Reference, P5 and TL against the annual AR and AtP boundaries (log axis), Monte Carlo 5-95% bands, TL zero-building years shaded; (b) Shapley waterfall of the cumulative LoE AR (AtP on the right axis): Reference -> P1-P4 -> P5 -> full strength from 2027 -> TL1-TL7 -> TL, budgets as lines, Monte Carlo whiskers, committed after 2050 as hatched companion bars, TL residual in dwellings and people
* Data: data/pathways/annual.csv, data/pathways/montecarlo_annual.csv, data/aesa/montecarlo_annual.csv, data/pathways/shapley_pathways.csv, data/pathways/shapley_theoretical_limit_moderate.csv, data/pathways/montecarlo_summary.csv, data/pathways/runs.csv, data/pathways/theoretical_limit.json
* Draft caption: Absolute sustainability of the Reference, P5 Combined and the theoretical limit. TL: hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H5, H8, H9; (v3.1): pb_2_loe, boss_05_annual_carbon_pb, fig_scenarios_pb, pw_4_annual_SI, pw_10_T_annual_SI, pw_2_shapley_waterfall, pw_8_staircase

### Fig6. Solution space: demand and intensity

* File: `outputs/paper/Fig6_solution_space.png` / `.pdf` / `.csv` (89 mm)
* Panels: cumulative LoE AR over uniform cuts of 2027-2050 floor area (x) and of non-soil carbon per m2 (y), 0-100%, LoE AR = 1 and LoE AtP = 1 contours; P1-P5 and TL at their effective coordinates
* Data: data/pathways/solution_space.csv, data/pathways/backcast.json, data/pathways/theoretical_limit.json
* Draft caption: Solution space (after Horup et al. 2025, Fig. 6). Markers sit at each run's effective reductions of 2027-2050 floor area and non-soil carbon per m2; TL also lowers soil carbon (TL5, TL6), which the plane does not show.
* Replaces (model-v1.1.0): H10; (v3.1): pw_3_solution_space

## Decisions of model-v1.0.0 (historical; figure ids of that release)

* **H11 (now ED1 / ED4), population rows: option A.** The population 5th / 95th rows change the AR boundary as well: their LoE is computed on each population path with the exact engine carbon of that path.
* **H10 (now Fig6), TL marker: yes**, at its effective coordinates, with the caveat that TL5 and TL6 lower soil carbon, which the plane does not show.
* **H4 (now Fig3), annual components: yes**, an exact decomposition of the annual carbon.
